share_using_ai_weekly.source: Stack Overflow 2025: 51% of professionals daily; 47.1% daily plus 17.7% weekly of all respondents

nondev_ai_builders_active.source: Lovable ~8M users, Bolt 5M+, Replit 40M (mostly free, overlapping); active non-developer builders

price_per_seat_month.source: anchored by the measured $20 entry tier; loosethreads as an add-on to AI tool spend

entrant_share.source: developers with under about 5 years; Stack Overflow 2025 reports early career (1 to 5 years) as a large group

web_frontend_share.source: developers doing web front end or full stack

paying_or_influencing_share.source: share who pay for AI tools themselves or choose them

paying_vibe_builders.source: Lovable ~$400M ARR / $30 to $50 a month = 0.67M to 1.1M; Replit 175K paying (Sacra); Bolt ~0.1M

high_end_share_of_paying_vibe.source: ship real products, pay for several tools, talk architecture or debt

reachable_share.source: English-first, web-first markets reachable at launch

som_penetration_3yr.source: share of SAM paying within 3 years, typical early devtools range

ai_coding_spend_2026_usd.source: Cursor >$2B annualized (Bloomberg via TechCrunch); Claude Code $2.5B run rate (Anthropic claim); Lovable ~$0.4B; Replit, Bolt, Copilot and others (Copilot assumed $1.5B to $4B)

incidents_per_month.source: stated time-loss incidents per active builder per month

hours_per_incident.source: median 3 hours lost per stated incident (n = 5,435 items; IQR 20 minutes to 48 hours, capped here)

hourly_value_usd.source: value of an hour of builder time

share_addressable.source: share of that time loss that contracts and gates address (drift, platform breaks, rework)
